verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Wadh-dhaariyaati dharwaa
Fal-haamilaati wiqraa
Fal-jaariyaati yusraa
Fal-muqassimaati amraa
Innamaa too'adoona lasaadiq
Wa innad-deena lawaaqi
Was-samaa'i dhaatil-hubuk
Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalif
Yu'ufaku anhu man ufik
Qutilal-kharraasoon
Al-ladheena hum fee ghamratin saahoon
Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud-deen
Yawma hum alan-naari yuftanoon
Dhooqoo fitnatakum haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihi tasta'jiloon
Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatin wa uyoon
Aakhidheena maa aataahum rabbuhum innahum kaanoo qabla dhaalika muhsineen
Kaanoo qaleelan minal-layli maa yahja'oon
Wa bil-ashaari hum yastaghfiroon
Wa fee amwaalihim haqqun lis-saa'ili wal-mahroom
Wa fil-ardi aayaatun lilmooqineen
Wa fee anfusikum afalaa tubsiroon
Wa fis-samaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon
Fawarabbis-samaa'i wal-ardi innahu lahaqqun mithla maa annakum tantiqoon
Hal ataaka hadeethu dayfi ibraaheemal-mukrameen
Idh dakhaloo alayhi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmun munkaroon
Faraagha ilaa ahlihi fajaa'a bi-ijlin sameen
Faqarrabahu ilayhim qaala alaa ta'kuloon
Fa-awjasa minhum kheefatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin aleem
Fa-aqbalati imra'atuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat ajoozun aqeem
Qaaloo kadhaaliki qaala rabbuki innahu huwal-hakeemul-aleem
Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal-mursaloon
Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmin mujrimeen
Linursila alayhim hijaaratan min teen
Musawwamatan inda rabbika lilmusrifeen
Fa-akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal-mu'mineen
Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghayra baytin minal-muslimeen
Wa taraknaa feehaa aayatan lilladheena yakhaafoonal-adhaabal-aleem
Wa fee moosaa idh arsalnaahu ilaa fir'awna bisultaanin mubeen
Fatawallaa biruknihi wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon
Fa-akhadhnaahu wa junoodahu fanabadhnaahum fil-yammi wa huwa muleem
Wa fee aadin idh arsalnaa alayhimur-reehal-aqeem
Maa tadharu min shay'in atat alayhi illaa ja'alathu kar-rameem
Wa fee thamooda idh qeela lahum tamatta'oo hattaa heen
Fa-ataw an amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumus-saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon
Famas-tataa'oo min qiyaamin wa maa kaanoo muntasireen
Wa qawma noohin min qablu innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Was-samaa'a banaynaahaa bi-ayydin wa innaa lamoosi'oon
Wal-arda farashnaahaa fani'mal-maahidoon
Wa min kulli shay'in khalaqnaa zawjayni la-allakum tadhakkaroon
Fafirroo ilaa Allaahi innee lakum minhu nadheerun mubeen
Wa laa taj'aloo ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nadheerun mubeen
Kadhaalika maa atal-ladheena min qablihim min rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon
Atawaasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taaghoon
Fatawalla anhum famaa anta bimaloom
Wa dhakkir fa-innadh-dhikraa tanfa'ul-mu'mineen
Wa maa khalaqtul-jinna wal-insa illaa liya'budoon
Maa ureedu minhum min rizqin wa maa ureedu an yut'imoon
Innallaaha huwar-razzaaqu dhul-quwwatil-mateen
Fa-inna lilladheena zalamoo dhanooban mithla dhanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon
Fawaylun lilladheena kafaroo min yawmihimul-ladhee yoo'adoon
